findings.text: The new condition only forces x64 for versions below 14.17.0 and for versions from 15.0.0 up to 16.0.0. Versions 14.17.0 through 14.x (for example v14.21.3) on darwin arm64 now keep NVM_ARCH=arm64. The patch's own comment says no binary distributions exist before v16, so the download URL (darwin-arm64) returns 404 and the install fails. Before the change these versions fell back to x64 correctly.
